title: Sound Masonry
subtitle: Test your understanding of Sound Masonry — acoustic frequencies that cut, dress, and levitate piezoelectric quartz granite into a self-sustaining Air-to-Earth circuit.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Sound masonry dresses and places quartz granite with tuned frequencies, then runs the finished building as an Air-to-Earth circuit that can heat rooms, supply hot water, and preserve food. Custodial inversion later turned those nodes into financial banks and economic debt loops.

questions.question: What is the primary mechanism sound masonry uses to shape and position massive stone blocks?

options.text: Electromagnetic induction coils that heat quartz crystals until the stone becomes malleable enough to mold, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The stone is not melted or thermally softened; targeted frequency waves fracture and position solid blocks directly.

options.label: B
options.text: Thermal expansion techniques paired with traditional iron chisels to shear crystalline planes cleanly, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Sound masonry completely eliminates entropic tools, saws, chisels, and thermal stress techniques.

options.label: C
options.text: High-pressure hydraulic resonance fields generated by subterranean water pumps beneath the footings, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Hydraulic mechanics play no role in shaping or levitating blocks, as sound waves perform all material manipulation.

options.label: D
options.text: Sound masonry uses targeted harmonic resonances and acoustic levitation to manipulate stone at the atomic and molecular levels.
options.rationale: Those frequencies dress and position stone without physical chisels, saws, or iron hammers.

questions.hint: Focus on how non-physical, wave-based phenomena interact directly with the crystalline lattice of the stone.
